scope: Exact literal non-news resource candidates from the frozen HTML audit. Historical evidence search is scoped; plan-only is not a request, and no recovery or archive-absence claim is made.
selection: Twenty guide/BC/Insider visuals and eighteen reused Armory icons. Two low-priority corner-border PNGs excluded.
